semanticContract.definition: Annual gross total remuneration in EUR includes salary, bonuses, benefits and image rights. Do not infer or add missing components.
semanticContract.presentationConvention: Annual gross total /52 follows the product's EA Sports FC Career Mode weekly presentation convention; it is not contractual weekly base salary, a payroll schedule or an EA-sourced value.
semanticContract.sourcePreservation: Keep original annual amount, raw source record, identity, club/league/season, effective and observation dates, hashes and provenance. Conversion passes provenance through without authenticating it.
semanticContract.missingAndInvalid: Undefined remains ABSENT/undefined; null remains NULL/null; explicit zero remains ZERO/0 without becoming an eligible log label. Reject non-numbers, negatives, non-finite values and positive underflow; never coerce strings.
semanticContract.precision: Finite IEEE-754 numbers divided by 52 with no monetary rounding. This converter does not promise exact decimal persistence or restore precision already lost by its caller.
semanticContract.eligibility: Arithmetic conversion grants no label eligibility or publication permission. FootyStats annual_salary_eur must not be relabelled GROSS/TOTAL without documentary evidence. Existing BASE references remain BASE.

legacyCompatibility.scope: modelVersion, reference, hypotheses, inputInventory, contract, normalization, validationPlan and referenceEligibility below describe the preserved legacy base-wage experiment, not eligibility for the new total-remuneration target.
legacyCompatibility.impact: BASE and TOTAL are different targets and cannot share labels or artifacts implicitly. Legacy runtime behavior, model/input/eligibility versions and artifact hashes remain unchanged. This method document has a new version and must not replace any frozen historical manifest.
legacyCompatibility.migration: None. No historical salary record, model coefficient, dataset or gate is modified. Only the new standalone conversion contract is available in this step.

reference.declared: Basic wages compiled from team/player press releases, major publications, experts/insiders and databases; ongoing review and corrections when better sources appear.

hypotheses: A: ln(gross base EUR/week) ~ OVR + continuous age. Simplest baseline, no coefficients fitted here.
B: add position as a secondary comparison using development only; retain only with defensible out-of-group gain.

Future: eligible observed market value and documented club economic capacity may explain purchasing power; compare on the same eligible subset without filling missing values. Club/league are initially split/report groups, not arbitrary multipliers. Performance only from verified dated observations.

real performance statistics (coverage and time alignment require audit)
excludedInitially: FutScout Potential: exists independently, no proven robust salary gain
market value: additional source rights required
missing: standardized club financial capacity such as dated revenue/payroll
inputInventory.rule: Never read legacy Player.marketValue; absent feature is not zero. No name coefficients or invented league/club tiers.

contract.inputHash: SHA256 canonical JSON of input schema version and original input values; sorted object keys, ordered arrays, finite numbers only, no ambient clock
contract.futureInputExtensions: Versioned observed-value amount/currency/effective date/source/identity and capacity/performance measures; changing feature schema requires new version/hash.
contract.artifactHash: SHA256 canonical complete artifact payload excluding artifactHash; includes coefficients, feature order, domain, provenance, version and evaluation state
contract.provenance: Preserve source record/season, observation and effective timestamps separately, identity evidence, verified/estimated status, original unit/tax/component and dated FX. Unknowns remain unknown.
contract.prediction: exp(linear log output), a log-scale center, not automatically an unbiased mean or confirmed contract
contract.applicabilityDomain: Current numeric ranges are synthetic test guards only; future domain must be derived from development support and externally validated.
contract.identityConfidence: Independent of statistical uncertainty; neither HIGH matching nor a finite prediction authorizes publication

normalization.rule: Require explicit GROSS and BASE, known currency and WEEK/YEAR. Reject NET/TOTAL/BONUS/UNKNOWN for base labels.
normalization.annualToWeekly: annualized base /52; documented comparison convention, not payroll calendar or total contract value
normalization.fx: EUR per original currency unit with source/date; multiply original amount, never infer an FX rate; original observation retained
normalization.missing: ABSENT, NULL, ZERO distinct; zero preserved but excluded from log-label fitting
normalization.bonus: Separate record/component, never added to base or inferred by subtracting incomparable totals
normalization.precision: Offline finite floating point only, no production monetary persistence; future dataset pins exact source decimals and conversion precision

validationPlan.gate: No real fit until rights, tax basis, identity and temporal alignment are documented. Current code has no trainer/DB/network/CLI data loader and accepts only its fixed synthetic artifact.
validationPlan.splits: Before any fit, freeze seed/algorithm/IDs/hashes. Group by club; assign all observations of a player to one split. Players spanning clubs connect those club groups. Reserve whole leagues; keep connected identities out of other splits.
validationPlan.fit: Fit normalization/coefficients on train only; compare A/B inside development grouped folds; calibrate intervals on separate calibration; freeze artifact and rules before holdout and unseen-league evaluation.
metrics: median absolute percentage error for positive base
validationPlan.abstention: Missing/incompatible inputs, unlicensed/unproven labels, sparse development support, unseen unsupported regimes and unusably wide intervals. Product must predeclare acceptable error/width and coverage tradeoffs; no arbitrary pass thresholds or holdout-tuned rules.
validationPlan.limits: Selection/provider availability bias must be reported. MLS alone does not validate global wages. Current EA ratings cannot be assumed contemporaneous with historical salary. Real-world estimates for gameplay are not EA Career Mode database salaries.

referenceEligibility.policy: Require documented CONFIRMED training AND calibration rights, HIGH independently evidenced identity, compatible club/season and explicit effective time. Evidence references require human/legal verification; the gate does not authenticate licenses.
referenceEligibility.temporal: Explicit UTC dates/instants and declared season bounds; effectiveAt <= referenceAt within the same season, observedAt >= effectiveAt. Never substitute observation date for effective date.
referenceEligibility.labels: OBSERVED and PROVIDER_ESTIMATE remain separate. GROSS/BASE only; bonus and total are rejected, never added. Normalize using existing normalizeBase to EUR/WEEK with documented dated FX.
referenceEligibility.precedence: Rights, identity, temporal, semantics, value; all detected reasons retained. RESTRICTED maps to RIGHTS_UNKNOWN with RIGHTS_RESTRICTED reason, never permission.
referenceEligibility.hashes: New versioned input/result hashes reuse engine.hash; ABSENT/NULL/ZERO are distinct. Unhashable invalid input yields null inputHash and explicit reason. Existing model/selection/artifact hashes unchanged.
referenceEligibility.limits: Zero preserved but ineligible for log fitting. Eligibility does not authorize training execution or publication. No real references loaded, no model fitted. Floating-point experimental normalization is not production monetary persistence.

nextStep: Obtain permission and compatible dated labels; authorize an independently frozen dataset and evaluation protocol before implementing or running a real trainer. No Economic State/Observation/Current or runtime integration.
